text: {"answer":"For a non-streaming body, `prepare_content_length` calls `super_len(body)` and sets `Content-Length` to the resulting length when it is nonzero. If there is no body and the method is neither `GET` nor `HEAD`, it sets `Content-Length` to `\"0\"`. For streaming bodies, it also uses `super_len`; if a length is available it sets `Content-Length`, otherwise it sets `Transfer-Encoding` to `\"chunked\"`.","file":"models.py","line":572}
